reports.title: In this report (the “Interim Report”), unless otherwise specified, the terms “we”, “our”, “us”, the “Group”, the “Company” and “Ferrari” refer to Ferrari N.V., individually or together with its subsidiaries, as the context may require.

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: 2026 guidance further upgraded, based on the updated assumptions:

desk.headline: Revenue up 7% to €1.90bn (+10% at constant currency) and profit up 13%; 2026 guidance raised again

numbers.eps_basis: diluted IFRS, in euro (adjusted diluted EPS was the same, no adjustments)

results: Net revenue rose 7.4% to €1.90bn (9.9% at constant currency) even though shipments slipped to 3,368 cars from 3,401 during a planned model changeover.
A richer mix, led by F80 supercar deliveries and more personalisation, lifted EBIT 12% to €563m despite a €45m currency hit and higher R&D; margin rose to 29.7%.
Net profit rose 13% to €431m and diluted EPS to €2.44 from €2.14; EBITDA of €753m beat a Reuters analyst poll of €739m.
Industrial free cash flow jumped 43% to €567m, leaving net industrial cash of €219m at end-September (net debt of €131m at end-June).
Shipments to mainland China, Hong Kong and Taiwan fell to 143 from 248, while the Americas and Europe grew; €608m of shares bought back so far this year.

guidance.summary: Ferrari raised its 2026 targets again: revenue of about €7.65bn, adjusted EBITDA of at least €3.0bn and adjusted diluted EPS of at least €9.85.

points: Personalisation passed 21% of car and spare-parts revenue, above the roughly 20% planned at the start of the year.
The first Ferrari Luce, its electric model, sold for a record $40m at auction; first deliveries are due in Q4 and 2027 output is fully allocated.
Management put weaker China shipments down to the model changeover and expects China shipments to rise year on year in Q4.
The CFO sees a full-year currency headwind of roughly €150–200m; Q4 will carry higher marketing and event costs and more depreciation from new models.
The order book now reaches into 2028, but management gave no 2027 numbers and will update in February.
call.source: Earnings call transcript (SingjuPost, 3 Nov 2026) and Reuters via TimesLIVE, 3 Nov 2026

watch: First Luce deliveries and the two remaining 2026 launches in Q4.
Whether China shipments recover as the new models arrive.
Currency drag and the first 2027 targets in February.
